--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
/-- The cosine of `π / 3` is `1 / 2`. -/
@[simp]
theorem cos_pi_div_three : cos (π / 3) = 1 / 2 := by
  have h₁ : (2 * cos (π / 3) - 1) ^ 2 * (2 * cos (π / 3) + 2) = 0 := by
    have : cos (3 * (π / 3)) = cos π := by
      congr 1
      ring
    linarith [cos_pi, cos_three_mul (π / 3)]
  cases' mul_eq_zero.mp h₁ with h h
  · linarith [pow_eq_zero h]
  · have : cos π < cos (π / 3) := by
      refine cos_lt_cos_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ?_ le_rfl ?_ <;> linarith [pi_pos]
    linarith [cos_pi]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Complex.Exponential
nonrec theorem cos_sq : cos x ^ 2 = 1 / 2 + cos (2 * x) / 2 :=
  ofReal_injective <| by simp [cos_sq]

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
theorem quadratic_root_cos_pi_div_five :
    letI c := cos (π / 5)
    4 * c ^ 2 - 2 * c - 1 = 0 := by
  set θ := π / 5 with hθ
  set c := cos θ
  set s := sin θ
  suffices 2 * c = 4 * c ^ 2 - 1 by simp [this]
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, sin_eq_zero_iff, hθ]
    push_neg
    intro n hn
    replace hn : n * 5 = 1 := by field_simp [mul_comm _ π, mul_assoc] at hn; norm_cast at hn
    omega
  suffices s * (2 * c) = s * (4 * c ^ 2 - 1) from mul_left_cancel₀ hs this
  calc s * (2 * c) = 2 * s * c := by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm 2]
                 _ = sin (2 * θ) := by rw [sin_two_mul]
                 _ = sin (π - 2 * θ) := by rw [sin_pi_sub]
                 _ = sin (2 * θ + θ) := by congr; field_simp [hθ]; linarith
                 _ = sin (2 * θ) * c + cos (2 * θ) * s := sin_add (2 * θ) θ
                 _ = 2 * s * c * c + cos (2 * θ) * s := by rw [sin_two_mul]
                 _ = 2 * s * c * c + (2 * c ^ 2 - 1) * s := by rw [cos_two_mul]
                 _ = s * (2 * c * c) + s * (2 * c ^ 2 - 1) := by linarith
                 _ = s * (4 * c ^ 2 - 1) := by linarith

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
@[simp]
theorem cos_pi_div_four : cos (π / 4) = √2 / 2 := by
  trans cos (π / 2 ^ 2)
  · congr
    norm_num
  · simp

--src: Mathlib.Data.Complex.Exponential
theorem cos_one_le : cos 1 ≤ 2 / 3 :=
  calc
    cos 1 ≤ |(1 : ℝ)| ^ 4 * (5 / 96) + (1 - 1 ^ 2 / 2) :=
      sub_le_iff_le_add.1 (abs_sub_le_iff.1 (cos_bound (by simp))).1
    _ ≤ 2 / 3 := by norm_num

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
/-- The square of the cosine of `π / 6` is `3 / 4` (this is sometimes more convenient than the
result for cosine itself). -/
theorem sq_cos_pi_div_six : cos (π / 6) ^ 2 = 3 / 4 := by
  rw [cos_pi_div_six, div_pow, sq_sqrt] <;> norm_num

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
/-- The sine of `π / 6` is `1 / 2`. -/
@[simp]
theorem sin_pi_div_six : sin (π / 6) = 1 / 2 := by
  rw [← cos_pi_div_two_sub, ← cos_pi_div_three]
  congr
  ring

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
/-- The sine of `π / 3` is `√3 / 2`. -/
@[simp]
theorem sin_pi_div_three : sin (π / 3) = √3 / 2 := by
  rw [← cos_pi_div_two_sub, ← cos_pi_div_six]
  congr
  ring

--src: Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
@[simp]
theorem cos_pi_div_thirty_two : cos (π / 32) = √(2 + √(2 + √(2 + √2))) / 2 := by
  trans cos (π / 2 ^ 5)
  · congr
    norm_num
  · simp

--src: Mathlib.Data.Complex.Exponential
nonrec theorem cos_three_mul : cos (3 * x) = 4 * cos x ^ 3 - 3 * cos x := by
  rw [← ofReal_inj]; simp [cos_three_mul]

id.content:
problem imo1963_p5 :
    Real.cos (π/7) - Real.cos (2*π/7) + Real.cos (3*π/7) = 1/2 := by
  rw [show (2*π/7) = π - (5*π/7) by linarith]
  rw [Real.cos_pi_sub]
  simp only [sub_neg_eq_add]
  have h : 2 * Real.sin (π / 7) ≠ 0 := by
    simp only [ne_eq, mul_eq_zero, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, false_or]
    apply ne_of_gt
    apply Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
    simp only [Nat.ofNat_pos, div_pos_iff_of_pos_right, Real.pi_pos]
    trans 1
    · rw [div_lt_one (by linarith only)]
      linarith only [Real.pi_le_four]
    · linarith only [Real.pi_gt_three]
  apply (mul_right_inj' h).mp
  rw [left_distrib, left_distrib]
  have prod_sum : ∀ (x y : ℝ),
      2 * Real.sin x * Real.cos y = Real.sin (x + y) - Real.sin (y - x) := by
    intro x y
    rw [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub]
    linarith only
  rw [prod_sum, prod_sum, prod_sum]
  rw [show (π / 7 + π / 7)     = 2 * π / 7 by linarith only]
  rw [show (π / 7 - π / 7)     = 0         by linarith only]
  rw [show (π / 7 + 5 * π / 7) = 6 * π / 7 by linarith only]
  rw [show (5 * π / 7 - π / 7) = 4 * π / 7 by linarith only]
  rw [show (π / 7 + 3 * π / 7) = 4 * π / 7 by linarith only]
  rw [show (3 * π / 7 - π / 7) = 2 * π / 7 by linarith only]
  rw [Real.sin_zero]
  ring_nf
  rw [← Real.sin_pi_sub]
  rw [show (π - π * (6 / 7)) = π / 7 by linarith]
  congr
  linarith

C1_dependencies.content:
@[simp]
theorem sin_pi_sub (x : ℝ) : sin (π - x) = sin x :=
  neg_neg (sin x) ▸ sin_neg x ▸ sin_antiperiodic.sub_eq'

  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, sin_add, sin_neg, cos_neg]

C1_dependencies.content:
theorem pi_le_four : π ≤ 4 :=
  (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (show (0 : ℝ) < 2 by norm_num)).1
    (calc
      π / 2 ≤ 2 := pi_div_two_le_two
      _ = 4 / 2 := by norm_num)

C1_dependencies.content: theorem div_lt_one (hb : 0 < b) : a / b < 1 ↔ a < b := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hb, one_mul]

    0 < (ofNat(n) : α) :=
  ofNat_pos'

C1_dependencies.name: Real.sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi
C1_dependencies.content:
theorem sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi {x : ℝ} (h0x : 0 < x) (hxp : x < π) : 0 < sin x :=
  if hx2 : x ≤ 2 then sin_pos_of_pos_of_le_two h0x hx2
  else
    have : (2 : ℝ) + 2 = 4 := by norm_num
    have : π - x ≤ 2 :=
      sub_le_iff_le_add.2 (le_trans pi_le_four (this ▸ add_le_add_left (le_of_not_ge hx2) _))
    sin_pi_sub x ▸ sin_pos_of_pos_of_le_two (sub_pos.2 hxp) this

C1_dependencies.content: lemma ne_of_gt (h : b < a) : a ≠ b := fun he => absurd h (he ▸ lt_irrefl a)

C1_dependencies.content:

equals zero. -/

theorem mul_eq_zero : a * b = 0 ↔ a = 0 ∨ b = 0 :=
  ⟨eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero,
    fun o => o.elim (fun h => mul_eq_zero_of_left h b) (mul_eq_zero_of_right a)⟩
